name: bilibili-video-reader
description: Extract Bilibili multi-P metadata and official/AI subtitles through a live MCP server. A local relay can use the user's own network and browser login state when Bilibili blocks cloud IPs.

interface.shortDescription: Read Bilibili subtitles and multi-P videos
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to a read-only MCP backend for Bilibili metadata and subtitles. The optional Windows local relay accesses Bilibili from the user's residential network and existing browser login state, avoiding cloud-IP HTTP 412 blocks.
defaultPrompt: 整理这个 B 站视频的字幕和方法。
把这个 B 站合集所有分 P 的题目和 Python 解法整理出来。
